newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cityhold buys 27 pct of Highland.
newsitem.headline: Cityhold buys 27 pct of Highland.

text.p: City Investment Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had bought a 27 percent stake in Highland Ceramics (Pty) Ltd from Lesotho National Development Corporation for 6.3 million rand.
The purchase is with effect from May 1 and will be settled by the issue of seven million Cityhold shares at 90 cents each in renounceable form.
The new Cityhold shares will be renounced by the vendors in favour of Spicer-Mitchell Holdings Ltd, Cityhold's shareholder, in exchange for nine million Spicer-Mitchell shares of 70 cents each.
Highland was established as a merger between Roma Tiles (Pty) Ltd and General Ceramic Industries Ltd in 1996.
Cityhold will have joint control of Highland with the original Roma shareholders.
Cityhold said the devaluation of the rand made the tile manufacturing industry more price competitive and the tile industry offered sound growth potential.
It said assuming the acquisition had been effective throughout the 15 months to December 31, 1996, the headline earnings per share of Cityhold would have been 8.20 cents versus 1.79 cents.
Spicer-Mitchell's headline earnings per share would have been 7.91 cents versus 3.40 cents.
